title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Evelyn Park
description: Context: Shipping several curated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates and agent/tool-calling examples to help developers get started quickly with Redwood's agent patterns and tool integrations. Motivation: reduce onboarding time for new users experimenting with RAG, demonstrate secure tool-calling patterns (HTTP, SQL, calendar), and surface quickstarts on the docs site. This PR bundles example code, template YAMLs, and docs site navigation updates so the quickstarts can be discovered from the main Getting Started flow. Changes: - Add RAG templates under examples/agents/templates (3 templates: faq-bot, multi-doc-search, and customer-support). - Add tool-calling examples for Python and TypeScript agents (HTTP fetch, database query, and shell-runner). - Add docs quickstart pages and guide (docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md) and wire into docs/_sidebar.yml and site config. - Minor update to SDK example to show tool schema registration. Checklist: - [x] Example templates added and documented - [x] Tool-calling examples for Python and TypeScript - [x] Docs quickstart page with step-by-step run instructions - [x] CI docs build passes - [x] Security note added for token handling Testing: unit tests for example scripts (smoke), local docs build via docs-ci, manual verification of quickstart end-to-end. Migration notes: none; examples are additive. How to run locally: follow docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md; use provided sample dataset and set REDWOOD_API_KEY; examples include a mock-tool server for offline testing. Related: builds on patterns introduced in ENG-1243 and references prior examples in pr-58001 and pr-58321.
